Handling E35L 800, GL6T 1,300, GL7T 2,800 CHF. PPR arrival + departure 50 + 50; PPR slot change 30 each (tick). Push & towing 365, lavatory 230, conveyor belt 196 (+15% admin). 'Administrational Fee' = 15% of airport fees + third-party services (conveyor, catering) → disbursement 15%. Swiss VAT 8.1% separately on invoice (not in panel). Airport fees (GVA, same at each handler): ATC E35L 326.50 / GL6T 500.30 / GL7T 552.50; landing per ton 8.80 below 50,001 kg (see the landing-per-ton paragraph at the end; 10.20 per ton applied until 17 Nov 2026), GL7T fixed 444.35 + 10.20 per ton above 50 t; indemnification 25% of landing; noise by noise class: class 5 (E35L, GL7T) 10, class 4 (GL6T) 40; ALX1·KBI and FLH 40 (earlier data); emissions 1.40 × the aircraft's engine emission value, and the figure stored in the panel is the resulting charge, not the value itself (E35L 5.05, GL6T 7.85, GL7T 14.55); per departing pax 27.90; airport slot fee 3 + 3. Landing/ATC for ALX1·KBI and FLH from earlier data (not verified by invoice); emissions unknown for these groups. Parking: per ton every started 24 h 7.50 CHF (Privatport invoices: E35L 25 t 24.7 h = 375, GL6T 46 t 15.4 h = 345, 45 t 27.9 h = 675); not charged by Dassault up to 1.5 h, first 2 h free assumed. Departing pax fee = departure tax 14.70 + security 13.20. Privatport handler prices from earlier data; airport fees updated with common tariff. SIGNATURE, first document check (17 Nov 2026): proforma G1166664 (TEST GLEX, private flight, LIML–LSGG–LOWW 24–28 Nov 2026, 7 pax) with the Geneva Airport fee simulation of 16 Nov 2026 behind it (GLEX 44,000 kg, noise class 4, emission value 5, wingspan C, cat 41). Changed: PPR request 115 (panel had 100, which is Dassault's 50 + 50; Signature charges one PPR fee, raised to 115 in every Signature group) and GPU GAP ground power unit 325 per hour (new, every Signature group). Signature bills the airport fees as one line 'Airport taxes / private flights' 2,560.80 and charges the 15% administration fee on that line only, which matches the panel's disbursement basis. The simulation confirms the whole GVA tariff independently: landing 387.20 = 44 t × 8.80, GABA indemnification 96.80 = 25% of landing, parking 1,320 = 4 started 24 h × 44 t × 7.50, emissions 7.00 = 1.40 × 5, departure tax 102.90 + security 92.40 = 7 × (14.70 + 13.20), de-icing ADIC 23.50, slot 3 + 3, noise class 4 = 40.
